Location comments: Trees were measured at Gates of Lodore Campground at mile 243.7, Wade and Curtis Camp at mile 241, Wild Mountain Camp at mile 229.4, Stateline Camp at mile 219.7. Mileage is measured upriver from the railroad bridge in Green River, Utah.
Tree comments: Tree at State Line Camp. Three ashes of similar size present. One rooted but on the ground and the other two leaning at a 45 degree angle.
